svg.title: Three views of the same results
svg.desc: You pick an exam and, if you want, a section. If the results are processed or published, three tabs show the same results: the merit list with everyone by position, the failed or absent students, and the pass/fail counts for each subject. Any open tab can be printed or downloaded as a CSV. A draft exam shows nothing.
